title: Paid-Month Floor of the Closing Home Oxygen Therapy Payment Period, by Coverage Class
content:
# Paid-Month Floor of the Closing Payment Period — Home Oxygen Therapy

**Rule.** A new Home Oxygen Therapy payment period after a break begins on the day home instead of the day of confirmation only when the payment period being closed has at least the number of paid equipment months below. Paid equipment months are the paid months less the reversed months under the coverage on the oxygen record. The coverage class is read from the patient's Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility records. When the condition fails, the new payment period begins on the day the patient confirms continuing.

| Coverage class on the oxygen record | Paid equipment months at least |
|---|---|
| Commercial PPO, Commercial HMO | 1 |
| Medicaid Fee-for-Service | 2 |
| any other coverage class | 3 |

## Both sides of each floor (hypothetical counts)

| Coverage class | Paid months | Reversed months | Count | Condition |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Commercial PPO | 1 | 0 | 1 | met |
| Commercial PPO | 1 | 1 | 0 | fails |
| Medicaid Fee-for-Service | 2 | 0 | 2 | met |
| Medicaid Fee-for-Service | 3 | 2 | 1 | fails |
| Original Medicare Part B | 3 | 0 | 3 | met |
| Medicare Advantage HMO | 4 | 2 | 2 | fails |
